official_paper: R-Bot: An LLM-based Query Rewrite System, PVLDB 18(12), 2025; arXiv:2412.01661
dependencies: Python 3.10; llama_index; chromadb; OpenAI/OpenAI-like or HuggingFace embedding path; psycopg2; sqlglot; JPype; PostgreSQL 14.13; OpenJDK 17
claimed_input_contract: SQL query plus schema/create_tables.sql plus PostgreSQL database config plus built RAG document/vector index over rewrite evidence
claimed_output_contract: complete rewritten SQL candidate plus selected rewrite rules/retrieval trace/logs; benchmark scripts write log directories
notes: Official README says datasets are TPC-H/DSB/Calcite and benchmark entrypoint is my_rewriter/test.py via test.sh. Feasible only after retrieval corpus/index and contamination policy are frozen.

official_paper: LLM-R2: A Large Language Model Enhanced Rule-based Rewrite System for Boosting Query Efficiency, arXiv:2404.12872
dependencies: Python >=3.8; transformers 4.2.1; torch; sentence_transformers; scikit-learn; pandas; OpenAI SDK; zss; psycopg2; Java JDK >=11; PostgreSQL 14.4; Calcite jars
claimed_input_contract: query CSV plus schema JSON plus positive/negative rule pools plus trained demonstration selector under src/simcse_models/
claimed_output_contract: CSV files with rewritten_sql_gpt plus intermediate outputs; Java rule applier returns complete rewritten SQL when rule sequence is valid
notes: Official clone includes a TPCH selector checkpoint, but code paths are dataset/layout-specific and call OpenAI directly; adapter needs a bounded one-row facade and output extraction guard before any Track A promotion.

official_paper: A Learned Query Rewrite System using Monte Carlo Tree Search, PVLDB 15(1), 2022; VLDB 2023 demo README
dependencies: JDK 11+; Apache Calcite jars bundled; optional HTTP server on port 6336; JSON schema; possible DB/stats hooks
claimed_input_contract: SQL query plus JSON schema/statistics; HTTP POST /rewriter accepts sql and schema
claimed_output_contract: JSON response with rewritten_sql, origin_sql, rewritten_cost, origin_cost, is_rewritten; test_workload writes workload_rewritten_result-like JSON
